title: OSF Autonomous NPC
description: Autonomous NPC intimacy interactions during idle/sandbox situations using OSF Animation.

settings.label: Enable Mod
settings.hint: Master switch for autonomous NPC interactions.

settings.label: Location Mode
settings.hint: Where autonomous scenes may trigger. Ship Only = player's ship interior. Ship + Outposts + Homes = any interior cell. Everywhere = no location restriction.

settings.label: Named Companions Only
settings.hint: Restrict to named companion followers (Sarah, Barrett, Sam, Andreja, etc). Generic crew can participate when disabled.

settings.label: Include Outpost NPCs
settings.hint: Also search for all nearby humanoid NPCs (outpost settlers, lodge residents, etc). Uses ActorTypeNPC keyword. Children and robots are still excluded.

settings.label: Trigger Chance (%)
settings.hint: Probability that an eligible pair will start a scene on each scan.

settings.label: Max Concurrent Scenes
settings.hint: Hard limit on simultaneous scenes. 1-2 for small/medium ships, 3-4 for large ships with 8+ crew.

settings.label: Actor Cooldown (game minutes)
settings.hint: Minimum in-game time before the same actor can participate in another scene.

settings.label: Min Scene Spacing
settings.hint: Minimum distance between concurrent scenes to prevent overlap. 500 = ~7m. Only matters when Max Concurrent Scenes is 2.

settings.label: Require Furniture
settings.hint: Only start scenes at beds/couches. Disable to allow standing scenes (may have positioning issues).

settings.label: FF Uses MF Animations
settings.hint: Allow female-female pairs to use male-female animations as fallback when dedicated FF scenes are unavailable. Unlocks 388+ GE scenes for FF pairs.

settings.label: Strip Mode
settings.hint: Control actor undressing during scenes. Inherit uses each scene pack's default. Kissing scenes always stay dressed regardless of this setting.

settings.label: Scene Duration Scale
settings.hint: Multiplier for scene loop counts. 1.0 = unchanged, 0.5 = shorter, 2.0 = longer.

settings.label: Allow Foreplay / Oral
settings.hint: Include kissing, blowjob, oral, handjob tags in rotation.

settings.label: Allow Classic Positions
settings.hint: Include missionary, cowgirl, spoon, facedown tags in rotation.

settings.label: Allow Intense Positions
settings.hint: Include doggy, reversecowgirl, riding, powerbomb tags in rotation.

settings.label: Animation Speed Mode
settings.hint: Static = fixed speed. Dynamic = starts slow, speeds up each stage. Random = random variation per scene.

settings.label: Romance Exclusivity Guard
settings.hint: Prevent romanced companions (relationship rank 4 = Lover) from participating in autonomous NPC scenes.

settings.label: Interrupt Scene on Walk-In
settings.hint: Stop running scenes if the player approaches. OFF by default to avoid interrupting scenes.

settings.label: Enable Solo Downtime
settings.hint: When no pairs are available, a single idle NPC may play a solo relaxation/self-pleasure animation.

settings.label: Solo Trigger Chance (%)
settings.hint: Chance of solo animation when no pair is found during a scan cycle.
